# stacklet_iac_policy_source (Data Source)

Fetch a Stacklet IaC policy source, a repository containing IaC policies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fetch an IaC policy source by name
data "stacklet_iac_policy_source" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the policy source.

### Read-Only

- `auto_scan` (Boolean) Whether the repository is periodically scanned for policy changes.
- `branch` (String) The branch scanned for policies. If null, the default branch is used.
- `extensions` (Set of String) The extensions of policy files.
- `paths` (Set of String) The directories scanned for policies. If null, the whole repository is scanned.
- `ssh_auth` (Attributes) Authentication to the remote repository with an SSH key, if configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssh_auth))
- `token_auth` (Attributes) Authentication to the remote repository with a user and password or token, if configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--token_auth))
- `url` (String) The URL of the remote repository.
- `webhook_url` (String) The URL of the webhook which triggers repository scans.

<a id="nestedatt--ssh_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssh_auth`

Read-Only:

- `has_passphrase` (Boolean) Whether the SSH private key has a passphrase.
- `user` (String) The user with access to the remote repository.


<a id="nestedatt--token_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `token_auth`

Read-Only:

- `user` (String) The user with access to the remote repository.
